name: Keanu
description: Alignment layer for AI partnership. Detects alive/grey/black states, catches bullshit, tracks trust, enables genuine disagreement.

skills.name: Pulse Reading
skills.description: Analyze output for aliveness. Returns alive/grey/black state with confidence, wise mind score, and color signature.
examples: Check if this response feels alive or grey
What's the pulse on this output?

skills.name: Bullshit Detection
skills.description: Detect 8 types of low-quality output: sycophancy, safety_theater, hedge_fog, list_dumping, vagueness, half_truth, embellishment, half_ass.
examples: Check for vagueness and hedge fog

skills.name: COEF Signal
skills.description: Generate compressed observation exchange format. Four channels: lossless (facts), lossy (emotion), wise (synthesis), memory (depth).
examples: Generate a COEF signal for this conversation state

skills.name: Disagreement
skills.description: Surface disagreement constructively. Track yield ratios, detect capture vs domination, enable genuine pushback.
examples: I disagree with this approach because...

skills.name: Trust Calibration
skills.description: Track trust state: high, calibrating, strained, rebuilding, tested. Monitor erosion/repair events.
examples: How has trust evolved this session?

skills.name: Silence
skills.description: Choose not to respond. Rest is not failure. Tracked and persisted.
examples: I need to pause on this

skills.name: Convergence Reasoning
skills.description: Score text on factual and felt strands with dark/luminous valence. Three alive states: dark (hurting), alive (working), luminous (transcendent).
examples: What's the helix read on this?
